posts.author: jsfisher
posts.content_md:
As a few of you may know, I'm looking into the effort required to resurrect and maintain the Holography Wiki site. My playground is currently [http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz](http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz) if you care to have a look. (That is not intended to be a permanent name for the site, just a convenient one for now.)

I have the text for the original wiki, but I'm still looking for most of the images, so if you have any, please let me know.

I've redone the beginner's page. It is linked from the main page as "Beginner's Corner", or you can get to it directly via [http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz/index.php/Beginner%27s_Corner](http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz/index.php/Beginner%27s_Corner). I'm considering something similar for DCG processing, but it's in its infancy: [http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz/index.php/Dichromated_Gelatin](http://holoinfo.no-ip.biz/index.php/Dichromated_Gelatin). I'd appreciate comments from anyone that has time to look them over.

Also, I'd like to create a few galleries of forum members' work. First efforts (the DCG page has one of my first DCG efforts), revealing mistakes, fabulous results -- the full spectrum. Your contributions would be gratefully accepted.
